item.text:
I continued the refactor in two directions.

First, I collapsed duplicated species behavior into shared lifecycle templates. [HerbivoreAnimal.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R006_module_java/HerbivoreAnimal.java:31), [CarnivoreAnimal.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R006_module_java/CarnivoreAnimal.java:37), and [Plant.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R006_module_java/Plant.java:65) now own the common step logic, while concrete species mostly supply constants and small hooks. That removes a lot of repeated `act` code from classes like [Sheep.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R006_module_java/Sheep.java:46), [Bear.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R006_module_java/Bear.java:52), and [Grass.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R006_module_java/Grass.java:42).

Second, I cleaned up reset/state ownership and stats typing. [DiseaseHandler.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R006_module_java/DiseaseHandler.java:27) no longer exposes a static timeline, [Simulator.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R006_module_java/Simulator.java:151) now properly resets the clock, weather, and disease state together, and [SimulatorView.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R006_module_java/SimulatorView.java:33) plus [FieldStats.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R006_module_java/FieldStats.java:14) use typed `Class<?>`/`Map` APIs instead of raw collections. I also tightened small utility logic in [SimulatorClock.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R006_module_java/SimulatorClock.java:107) and removed some dead/static coupling.

Verification: the refactored core simulation classes compile successfully. Full project compilation is still blocked here by the existing JavaFX dependency in `Dashboard.java`, so I validated the simulation path with temporary UI stubs again.
